text:
Rae (Design): quick UX sync — compact dashboard tiles: legend wrapping pushes charts too far down when there are 5+ series. Proposal: collapsed legend (icons only) with a reveal-on-hover/expand-on-click. Thoughts? :mag:
Leo (Frontend): collapsed icons + visually-hidden text for screen readers works. On mobile expand-on-click makes more sense.
Marta (Product): agree. also Units toggle copy: switch to 'Units: Auto | Raw' (Auto = humanized). Customers misread 'Exact' previously.
Ibrahim (Data): for Auto, snap tick marks to human-friendly steps (1,2,5 * 10^n) so small tiles don't show decimals like 1.2K. We'll compute snap based on peak value per tile.
Rae (Design): good — add a tiny label on hover: 'Auto abbreviates numbers (K, M)'. keep it concise.
Leo (Frontend): smoothing note: current spline interpolation is causing slight overshoot on drops. Ops prefers fidelity. Recommend default Smoothing="None" for tiles, optional "Soft (spline)" in detail view.
ops-bot: incoming: ops ask to avoid visual artifacts that suggest non-existent dips. default to linear/no-smoothing unless user opts in.
Marta (Product): let's default to fidelity. show 'Soft' with tooltip: 'smooths noise, may alter peak values'.
Ibrahim (Data): outlier policy: two asks — clamp vs show full range. Suggest clamp by default at 3x IQR, add legend action 'Show full range (includes outliers)'. Also add an affordance to zoom to outliers.
Leo (Frontend): interaction plan: collapsed legend -> kebab menu -> 'Show full range' and 'Zoom to outliers'. aria-labels will be explicit.
a11y-bot: accessibility checks: 1) collapsed legends must remain keyboard-focusable; 2) touch targets >=44px on mobile; 3) hairline (<1px) gridlines must still meet contrast >=3:1 vs background. Provide token variants grid-small/grid-default.
Rae (Design): will produce side-by-side mocks: current vs collapsed legend, and grid-small vs grid-default. annotate contrast levels and smoothing behavior.
Marta (Product): rollout plan: dashboards first; embeds stay legacy for one release. run a 2-week AB test measuring perceived readability + support mentions about 'missing spikes'.
Leo (Frontend): I'll prototype CSS/Canvas samples and include perf notes. sample canvas tweak: ctx.translate(0.5,0.5) for crisp thin lines.
Ibrahim (Data): add hover microcopy on sampled tiles: 'Preview shown — open chart for full data.' avoids support confusion.
Rae (Design): perfect. I'll tag this ready-for-design-qa after mocks are up. :white_check_mark:
